title: IoT IP camera pre-auth RCE
summary: Pre-authentication remote code execution on a consumer IP camera, achieving a root shell on the device. Reported to KISA; details withheld until the disclosure period ends.

title: PostgreSQL pgcrypto heap overflow
summary: Integer overflow in PGP session-key parsing leading to a heap overflow; built a working exploit from the advisory. Write-up coming soon.

title: Exim SMTP AUTH out-of-bounds write
summary: Unauthenticated out-of-bounds write in the SMTP AUTH handler; reproduced the bug and the path to code execution. Write-up coming soon.

title: ipTIME UPnP OS command injection
summary: Command injection in the UPnP service; root-cause analysis and reproduction on real firmware.
